insights.deepseek_advice: For tweets making parallel celebrity-X-politician claims, search for the most checkable sub-claim first (here: De Niro's recent work, established celebrity endorser lists) and use 'fact check' as a suffix — the De Niro angle was already debunked by multiple outlets, which reveals the tweet's fabrication pattern. Also check if claimed events are temporally coherent: here the 'wealth tax' was announced after the tweet was posted, an internal contradiction a one-shot model can surface by noting the tweet date vs. known policy timeline.
